text: {"assertions":["An off-by-one error in a slice bound of worker/scheduler/cron.py caused missed runs in the background job scheduler when two requests raced on the same key.","The scheduler bug manifested as execution slots with no execution records.","The fix for the missed-run bug was submitted in PR #2185 on branch fix/missed-run-1.","A property test was added to tests/worker/test_cron.py to prevent regression of the off-by-one error.","The missed-run bug could be reproduced by advancing the fake clock across the schedule.","The backlog cleared 82 minutes after the deployment of the scheduler fix on 2026-03-07."]}
